name: Rivera at the Valley
paymentPlan: 10% down payment; 80% during construction; 10% on handover
overview: Emaar Properties presents Rivera at the Valley, an exclusive development offering a limited collection 4-bedroom Villas in a serene, nature-inspired community. With only 378 units Rivera combines modern elegance with the tranquility of lush green surroundings. The development is set for completion in the fourth quarter of 2028.
